question.html:
The pressure exerted by gases in the atmosphere is crucial for weather prediction.

a

Derive the relationship for an ideal gas, where is the density and is the root mean square (rms) speed of gas particles.

[3]

b

Calculate the pressure exerted by a gas in a 2 m container at a temperature of 350 K, given the density is 1.2 kg/m and the root mean square (rms) speed of the molecules is 500 m/s.
